story_title: Lina and Adams and the Lost Puppy
lesson: Learn pet and animal words in English!
title: Lina and Adams and the Lost Puppy 🐶 | Learn Pet Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Lina and Adams find a little lost puppy! Can they help him find his home? 🐶🐦🐠
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: puppy, lost, sad, bird, fish, help and happy. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🐶 puppy — جرو / كلب صغير — chiot
❓ lost — ضائع — perdu
😢 sad — حزين — triste
🐦 bird — عصفور — oiseau
🐠 fish — سمكة — poisson
🤝 help — يساعد — aider
😊 happy — سعيد — heureux

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: pause after each new word and ask your child to say it out loud. Ask them: what pet do you like? Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: Lina and Adams are walking down the street.
Suddenly, they hear a little sound. Woof! Woof!
Look, Lina! A puppy!
He is so small and so cute!
A puppy is a baby dog.
Can you say it with me? Puppy!
Where is his family? I don't see anyone.
I think the puppy is lost.
When we cannot find our way home, we are lost.
Say it with me: lost!
Don't worry, little puppy. We will help you.
The puppy puts his head down. His ears are down too.
Oh, the puppy looks sad.
He misses his family.
When we feel like crying, we feel sad.
Can you say it? Sad!
Lina gives the puppy a gentle pat. Good puppy.
Lina and Adams take the puppy to the park. Maybe his family is there.
Tweet, tweet! A little blue bird is singing in the sky.
Hello, bird! Did you see this puppy's family?
The bird flies to the big tree, and sings again. Tweet!
A bird has wings and feathers. Many birds can fly.
Say it with me: bird!
Next, they knock on the door of a house with a garden.
There is a fish bowl by the door. A little orange fish is swimming. Swish, swish!
Look, a fish! It lives in the water.
Milo the cat looks at the fish. Meow?
No, Milo! The fish is a friend!
A fish lives in water. It swims with its fins and tail.
Can you say it? Fish!
A kind grandma opens the door.
Hello! This puppy is lost. Can you help us find his home?
The grandma smiles. I know this puppy! He lives in the blue house, at the end of the street.
Thank you for your help!
When we do something good for someone, we help them.
Say it with me: help!
Lina and Adams walk to the blue house. A little boy is crying outside.
The puppy runs to the boy. Woof, woof, woof!
The little boy hugs his puppy. Thank you, thank you! You found my puppy!
Now the puppy is not sad. He is happy!
When we smile and feel good, we are happy.
Can you say it? Happy!
At home, Milo the cat jumps on the bed. Meow!
Today we found a lost puppy. He was sad.
We met a bird and a fish. And a kind grandma helped us.
And now the puppy is happy at home.
And you are our happy cat, Milo!
Milo purrs. Purr, purr. Good night, friends.
